title: Fire Mountain
opening: The rockslide is gone. Now we climb Fire Mountain! A dragon sleeps at the top. Its smoke is what made everything sick. Chase it away!
not_yet: Not that way! The rocks are too hot. Follow the clue!

steps.clue: Start at the Cool Waterfall. Fill your wand with water. Dragons hate getting wet!
Next, the Burnt Oak. Wave your wand and the leaves grow back green!
The Smoky Cave is full of dragon smoke. Shine your wand and blow it out!
Almost at the top. The Lava Mushrooms are glowing hot. Cool them off with a wave!
Here is the Dragon Lair! The dragon has eight leaves of power. Zap it again and again until the leaves are gone. Hurry, or it breathes fire and grows them back!

ending: WHOOSH! The dragon flies away over the rainbow. The smoke is gone. The water is clean, the caves glow, and the unicorns dance. The whole realm is healed. Liza, you are a Master Magi!
